goal: How can I get more use out of my utility knife?
candidate_1: When the blade in your utility knife gets dull, it’s usually only the point and the first 1/4 in. or so that’s bad and you can get additional life from your blade by snapping off the point with a pliers (wear safety glasses) it won’t cut quite as well as a fresh blade, but a lot better than the dull one.
candidate_2: When the blade in your utility knife gets dull, it’s usually only the point and the first 1/4 in. or so that’s bad and you can get additional life from your blade by snapping off the point with a bare finger (wear safety glasses) it won’t cut quite as well as a fresh blade, but a lot better than the dull one.
attention_note: Head-averaged slices; goal slice excludes other keys; cross slice omits CLS sink; rows need not sum to one.
